Technical Merit vs. Emotional Core: The mechanics of the poem are bad, but the emotion behind it is real to her. The Next Week Factor: This is triage mode not surgery mode. The Strategy: Praise the Soul, Tweak the Sound. The best approach is to validate the vulnerability and emotion of the piece and frame any constructive feedback around how it sounds when spoken aloud. This naturally addresses forced rhymes and clunky structure without you having to say your rhymes are forced.
